title: 第8章 和前世一模一样的发展

content_zh:
韩露露的声音都在发抖，不知道是害怕还是气的。
“脸都不要了，还不敢承认。”贺御翔的笑声里都是恶意，“不就想当我女朋友吗，躲什么躲？再说你都准备这么充分了，我总得给你个面子吧，我可以答应你……”
贺御翔说着就伸手去抓韩露露的胳膊。
韩露露还没来得及躲呢，更多的脚步声传来。
紧接着，手电筒的光开始乱晃，最终对准了韩露露和贺御翔所在的方向。
“谁在哪儿！”韩军栋的声音十分严厉，“我倒是要看看谁那么不要脸，三更半夜跑这儿谈恋爱！”
“小小年纪不学好，就知道谈恋爱，你们爹妈送你们来是学习的还是让你们谈恋爱的？”
“三更半夜孤男寡女，你们还要不要脸？不知羞耻。这么想谈恋爱还当什么学生？”
韩军栋一边呵斥着，一边快步上前。
可是当他手电筒的光对准了女孩子的脸时，韩军栋顿时哽住，还有一肚子骂人的话准备说，此刻却一个字都说不出来。
怎么是……
怎么是自己的闺女，韩露露！
再看看韩露露这会儿的样子，衣服湿了，整个人显得狼狈不堪，又跟贺御翔拉拉扯扯的。
韩军栋气得肺都要炸了，可是却完全不敢高声开口训斥。
他比谁都清楚，他要是一喊，露露就别在学校做人了。
这事儿啊，最好就是悄悄地过去，他再私底下好好教育女儿。
可是偏偏，后面跟他一起来的学生纪律检查小组，也来了。
“韩主任，韩主任你找到人了，我们马上过来，绝对不让他们跑掉！”
一群学生围了上来。
“韩主任，他们这是公然违反校规，这么晚了在小桃林里约会……”

“就是啊韩主任，按照学校规定是不是要通报批评，要叫家长，还要在全校大会上公开检讨？”
一群学生还没看清楚偷偷在这儿“早恋”的男生女生到底是谁，身为纪律检查小组，他们七嘴八舌地议论开了。
“哎，跟我没关系啊。”
千夫所指的时候，贺御翔忽然开口了。
石缝中躲着的云画，立刻就抿紧了唇，冷冷地看着桃林碑那边。
果然，贺御翔接下来的话，就跟前世云画经历过的一模一样。
“是她给我发短信约我过来的，我可没想来，是她勾.引我的，跟我没一点关系啊。”
贺御翔把自己撇得干干净净。
“怎么会跟你没关系？要是你们俩不是约好的话，她想让你来你就来？还不是揣着什么坏心思，当谁不知道呢。”
七嘴八舌，人言可畏。
韩露露羞得满脸通红，被自己的老爸和这么多学生当场抓住，真是恨不得找个地缝钻进去！
不过呢，谁让她有个老爸叫韩军栋呢。
韩军栋在最初的愤怒之后，已经平静下来。
他转头看向一群学生。
“今天晚上我们对校园不.良行为进行检查，发现贺御翔、韩露露私自早退，这种行为严重违反了学校规定，现在给予口头批评，另外，下周一之前，每人交一份五千字的检查！”

content_en:
Han Lulu's voice was trembling. She didn't know whether it was fear or anger.
"I don't even dare to admit it." He Yuxiang's laughter was filled with malice. "Don't you just want to be my girlfriend? Why are you hiding? Besides, you are so well prepared. I have to give you some face. I can promise you..."
He Yuxiang said and reached out to grab Han Lulu's arm.
Before Han Lulu could hide, more footsteps came.
Immediately afterwards, the light of the flashlight began to flicker around, and finally pointed in the direction of Han Lulu and He Yuxiang.
"Who is there!" Han Jundong's voice was very stern, "I want to see who is so shameless and comes here to fall in love in the middle of the night!"
"If you don't learn well at a young age, you only know how to fall in love. Did your parents send you here to learn or to fall in love?"
"A man and a woman alone in the middle of the night, why do you still have no shame? You are shameless. Why are you still a student if you want to fall in love so much?"
Han Jundong scolded and stepped forward quickly.
But when the light of his flashlight was pointed at the girl's face, Han Jundong suddenly choked up and had a lot of curse words ready to say, but at the moment he couldn't say a word.
How is it...
Why is she my daughter, Han Lulu!
Look at Han Lulu's appearance now. Her clothes are wet, she looks embarrassed, and she is tugging at He Yuxiang again.
Han Jundong was so angry that his lungs were about to explode, but he did not dare to reprimand loudly.
He knew better than anyone else that if he shouted, Lulu would stop being a good person in school.
It's best to get over this matter quietly, and he can educate his daughter in private.
However, the student discipline inspection team that came with him later also came.
"Director Han, Director Han, you have found the person. We will come over immediately and we will never let them escape!"
A group of students gathered around.
"Director Han, they are blatantly violating school rules by having a date in the peach forest so late..."
"That's right, Director Han. According to school regulations, do we need to report criticism, call parents, and publicly review it at a school meeting?"
A group of students hadn't yet figured out who the boys and girls secretly had "puppy love" here. As a disciplinary inspection team, they started talking about it.
"Hey, it has nothing to do with me."
When Qian Fu pointed it out, He Yuxiang suddenly spoke.
Yun Hua, who was hiding in the cracks in the rocks, immediately pursed his lips and looked coldly at the Taolin Monument.
Sure enough, what He Yuxiang said next was exactly the same as what Yun Hua had experienced in his previous life.
"She sent me a text message asking me to come over. I didn't expect to come. She was the one who seduced me. She has nothing to do with me."
He Yuxiang kept himself clean.
"How come it has nothing to do with you? If you two hadn't made an appointment, you would have come if she wanted you to come? She didn't have some bad intentions, just pretend that she doesn't know."
There are so many talking heads and people's words are terrifying.
Han Lulu's face turned red with embarrassment. Being caught on the spot by her father and so many students, she really wanted to find a crack in the ground and crawl in!
However, who told her to have a father named Han Jundong.
Han Jundong has calmed down after his initial anger.
He turned to look at a group of students.
"Tonight we inspected the bad behavior on campus and found that He Yuxiang and Han Lulu left early without permission. This behavior seriously violated the school regulations. We will now give them verbal criticism. In addition, before next Monday, each person will submit a 5,000-word inspection!"
